description: Fix the progress matrix dropdown visibility issue when only one student exists in Full Grid View, and add helper text/tooltips to clarify the difference between Level View and Full Grid View.
steps: Step 1: Update src/renderer/css/progress-matrix.css - Change .progress-cell-dropdown positioning to detect available space. Add a CSS rule for .progress-cell-dropdown.open-upward that positions the dropdown above the cell (bottom: 100% instead of top: 100%). Increase .matrix-content min-height to 400px.

Step 2: Update src/renderer/js/screens/progress-matrix.js attachCellEvents() - When toggling the dropdown, calculate whether the dropdown would overflow the viewport bottom. If so, add class 'open-upward' to the dropdown element. Remove the class when it would fit below normally.

Step 3: Add min-height to .matrix-grid-container and .matrix-full-grid .matrix-scroll-wrapper (at least 350px) so that even with a single row, there is enough vertical space for the dropdown to appear.
Step 4: Add .progress-cell-dropdown z-index to 100 (currently 50) so it renders above sticky headers and other elements.

Step 5: Add helper text near the view tabs in the progress-matrix screen. After the .matrix-view-tabs div, add a .matrix-view-helper paragraph that describes the current view. When switching tabs, update the helper text: Level View = 'عرض مركز يظهر المستوى المختار وجميع الطلاب والسور المسندة إليه' (A focused view showing one selected level with its students and assigned surahs), Full Grid View = 'عرض شامل يظهر الشبكة الكاملة لجميع الطلاب بشكل مشابه لجدول Excel' (A comprehensive view showing the full grid of all students in an Excel-like format). Also add helpers for Student View and Surah View.
Step 6: Update the matrix-status-legend to use position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 5 so it remains visible while scrolling the matrix content.
acceptance_criteria: When only one student exists and the full grid view is active, clicking a cell shows the dropdown fully visible (not clipped)
The dropdown opens upward when there is not enough space below
Helper text is shown below the view tabs explaining the current view
The status legend remains visible while scrolling the grid
No CSS regressions in other views
verification: Run npx jest --no-coverage to confirm no test regressions
Visually inspect the CSS changes are syntactically valid
